The '''most comfortable chair ever designed''' was a gigantic, floating, rocking [[Pillow/Legends|pillow]]. The [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilot]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] kept the chair in the center of his [[Han Solo's sky house|sky house]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="ZTHR" /> In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="Readers">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]'', which includes [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] housewarming party, in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> Solo hosted a housewarming party at the sky house, where the most comfortable chair ever designed was reserved for his guest of honor, the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].<ref name="ZTHR" />

While seated, Organa relaxed through the chair's gentle rocking motion and closed her [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], allowing her to forget her concerns about her secret operations for the [[Senate Planetary Intelligence Network]]. Solo played the role of host beneath the most comfortable chair ever designed, introducing his guests to Organa one by one.<ref name="ZTHR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The most comfortable chair ever designed appeared in the [[1992]] junior novel ''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]'', the third entry in the [[Adventures of a Jedi Prince|''Jedi Prince'']] series by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]].<ref name="ZTHR" />
